preprocessing: SAM ViT-H, original crop and point settings, full-resolution LERF-OVS images, all views; COS3D level-3 masks and OpenCLIP ViT-B-16 laion2b_s34b_b88k. Cached full-level preprocessing and equivalent large-level-only preprocessing. Validation on Teatime frame_00001: identical masks, maximum FP16 CLIP feature difference 0.0009765625.
anchor_reconstruction: Official release omits language anchors; rebuilt from checkpoint semantics with gsplat 1.5.3, full camera list, level-3 mask means and global median pixel-feature distance. This is local inference, not a new benchmark evaluation.
ddn: Existing published scene and query masks reused without re-inference.
protocol: Official COS3D kernel grounding and greedy grouping; exact SciPy KNN with upstream in-place 10000-point smoothing batches; original thresholds; existing DDN queries and cameras; all queried foreground retained plus up to 900000 background Gaussians.
display_camera: Shared cameras.js preserves each existing query camera position and FOV, and centers both views on the coordinate-wise median of DDN query foreground centers with opacity above 0.1. Framing does not change either segmentation mask.
precision: SAM FP32; early cached full-level frames used TF32 matmul, later large-level-only processing disables TF32 matmul. OpenCLIP FP16; language anchors and grounding FP32.
